lines.t: Born in shadows, bruised and breaking
Tiny hands learn fear, not safety
Wounds carved deep in tender childhood
Left a heart that learned to hide the pain away
Coping came like poison comfort
Adolescents wore a twisted crown
Each rebellion was a scream for healing
But every step was hatred pulling heaven down
Sin is sin no matter how it's borne
Even in our brokenness we won the sacred one
But blood flows deeper than the curse we've worn
From ashes to glory
From death into life
His blood breaks the chains, conquers darkness and night
The penalty's paid, every spiritual scar
Death's hold is shattered, he's healing from a father
And for a generation, the curse runs its course
But blessings to thousands when we turn to the source
In Yahushua's love we're made completely whole
Spirit, mind and body, restoration of the soul
The gospel came like lightning breaking
Split the veil I built around my shame
His love reached through my devastation
Spoke my name before I knew his name
Learning now to walk in obedience
Training control for his gentle hand
A budding end
His love means dying daily
Surrendering to what I don't understand
Broken bonds from childhood hurt
And chains of pathways in my mind
But holding close to Christ our Savior
His love rewires the broken left behind
From ashes to glory
From death into life
His blood breaks the chains, conquers darkness and night
The penalty's paid, every spiritual scar
Death's all to shatter, he's healing from a fathered and fourth generation
The curse runs its course, for blessings to thousands
When we turn to the source, in Yahushua's love
We're made completely whole, spirit, mind and body
He took my sin, though he had none
Crucified the penalty, the victory won
Not just forgiven, made virgin, made new
Every thought rewiring, making all things true
The Father's healing flows like rivers
Mending places broken deep within
Perfect love where fear once lived
New ways of thinking formed in Jesus' name
From ashes to glory
From death into life
His blood breaks the chains, conquers darkness and night
The penalties paid, every spiritual scar
Death's hold is shattered, He's healing from a far generation's bliss
When we receive His grace, the curse is broken by His sacrifice
In Yahushua's love we're made completely whole
Spirit, mind and body, restoration of the soul
From trauma to triumph, from bondage to free
Restarting His image the way we're meant to be
you
